battle.name: 漢摩拉比的征服
battle.theater: 美索不達米亞平原與迪亞拉河谷
battle.brief: 前1801至前1770年，埃蘭自蘇斯越過札格羅斯山脈攻入美索不達米亞平原，攻滅埃什努納；巴比倫王漢摩拉比聯合馬里王齊姆里利姆與北方諸邦，逐出埃蘭軍，隨後兼併拉爾薩與馬里。卡面埃及長矛屬早王朝青銅工藝，雖出自尼羅河谷，形制卻與本役步兵的銅矛頭木杆長矛相同，正是當時近身戰的骨幹裝備。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場戰爭是前1801至前1770年埃蘭入侵美索不達米亞、以及巴比倫聯盟將其逐出的整輪衝突。埃蘭一方以伊朗高原西南的蘇斯為中心，王庭設在蘇斯城，國王自任全軍最高統帥，軍隊以步兵方陣與車兵為骨幹，沿札格羅斯山脈的缺口東下，先取迪亞拉河谷的埃什努納，再佔美索不達米亞平原的東北部；後世記載把埃蘭系的密集楔形衝鋒與他們相連，善用投槍壓制後近身纏鬥。巴比倫一方是阿摩利特人第一王朝，國王漢摩拉比親自領兵並兼最高指揮，兵員來自巴比倫王田與屬城的臨時徵召，分為步行兵與水上游擊兵兩類，平時並無常備職業軍。馬里是聯盟的實際支柱，王齊姆里利姆位居幼發拉底中游，國力與巴比倫相當，北方諸邦亦出兵相助。埃什努納原是迪亞拉河谷的獨立王國，被埃蘭吞併後由族長西利辛被立為王，成為巴比倫接管的對象。拉爾薩的里姆辛一世是南方另一強國，本與巴比倫對立，卻在埃蘭分化下與巴比倫結盟，隨後又淪為頭號目標。雅姆哈德等北方城邦在聯軍中提供兵力，使巴比倫得以在兩河以外維持存在。
countriesEn: This war covers the whole round of conflict in which, between roughly 1801 and 1770 BC, Elam invaded Mesopotamia and the coalition led by Babylon drove it out again. On the Elamite side the heartland lay in the south-west of the Iranian plateau, with the royal court seated at Susa; the king of Elam was himself the supreme commander of the host, whose backbone was made up of infantry blocks and war chariots. Moving down through the gaps of the Zagros, the Elamite forces first took Eshnunna in the Diyala valley and then occupied the north-east of the Mesopotamian plain. Later accounts connect the dense wedge-shaped charge with Elamite warfare, in which javelins were used to pin an enemy down and the fight was then carried on hand to hand. On the Babylonian side stood the first dynasty of Babylon under the Amorites, with the king Hammurabi himself leading the host and holding supreme command; the troops were drawn from the royal domains and the dependent cities by levy rather than from any standing professional army, and were divided between foot soldiers and river patrols. Mari was the real pillar of the coalition: its ruler Zimri-Lim sat on the middle Euphrates with resources comparable to Babylon's, and the northern city states sent troops of their own. Eshnunna, once an independent kingdom in the Diyala valley, had been swallowed by Elam and now wore a king who was no prince at all but a local clan chief, Silli-Sin, and it was to this kingdom that Babylon would next turn. Rim-Sin I of Larsa, the other great power of the south, had long been Babylon's rival and was drawn into alliance with it only because Elam had tried to set the two apart; he later became Babylon's foremost target. Yamhad and other northern states appear in the coalition as well, and they allowed Babylon to keep a presence beyond the two rivers.
people: 漢摩拉比是阿摩利特人王室辛-穆巴利特之子，約前1792年即位，在位43年，前1750年病死，出生年份不詳，可能是即位時仍十分年輕。出身二等城邦巴比倫的他，靠聯盟、突襲與把握時機而成為兩河霸主；罕見的是他留下了二百多封親筆書信，是美索不達米亞諸王中留書最多的一位。馬里王齊姆里利姆是關鍵盟友，與漢摩拉比以沙瑪什與阿杜神名立誓結盟，聯手對抗埃蘭。拉爾薩王里姆辛一世在位約六十年，長期稱霸南部，卻在最後階段被生擒帶出城門，是本役最具象徵性的結局。上美索不達米亞的強人薩姆西阿杜於前1775年死後，其王國迅速崩解，才讓出埃什努納與馬里之間的真空。埃什努納被埃蘭佔領後，其貴屬越過血統另立平民出身的族長西利辛為王；漢摩拉比的女兒後來嫁給他，兩人之間的和平談判拖延整整一年，最終破裂。巴比倫方面的執行者包括總務官辛-貝爾-阿普利姆、負責徵兵的總督辛-伊達南，以及經手軍人土地分配的山馬什-哈齊爾；馬里方面則有雅里姆-阿杜、齊姆里-阿杜等書記官往返傳遞軍情。
peopleEn: Hammurabi was the son of the Amorite royal house of Sin-Muballit, came to the throne at about 1792 BC, reigned for 43 years and died of illness at about 1750 BC; his year of birth is unknown, and he may have been very young when he acceded. Coming from the second-rank city of Babylon, he rose to dominate the two rivers through alliances, surprise attacks and a readiness to seize the moment; remarkably, he left behind more than two hundred letters in his own hand, more than any other Mesopotamian king. Zimri-Lim, king of Mari, was the decisive ally, and the two bound themselves to one another by oath in the names of Shamash and Addu before joining hands against Elam. Rim-Sin I of Larsa reigned for about sixty years and long dominated the south, yet in the final stage he was taken alive and led out of his city, which is the most symbolic outcome of the whole war. When the great man of Upper Mesopotamia, Samsi-Addu, died in 1775 BC, his kingdom broke up quickly and left a vacuum between Eshnunna and Mari for Elam to occupy. After Elam had taken Eshnunna, its notables set aside the rules of blood and enthroned a commoner of a local clan, Silli-Sin; a daughter of Hammurabi was later married to him, and the peace negotiations between the two dragged on for a full year before collapsing. On the Babylonian side the men who carried the work out were the chief of staff Sin-Bel-Aplim, the governor Sin-iddinam who was repeatedly called upon to raise troops, and Shamash-hazir, who allocated land from the royal domain to soldiers; on the Mari side envoys such as Yarim-Addu and Zimri-Addu carried the news back and forth.
kits: 卡面所示為埃及長矛，屬早王朝時期工藝，銅或青銅矛頭以綁紮方式固定在木杆上，是近東青銅時代最基本的長兵器。本役的美索不達米亞步兵所用的正屬同一類：銅矛頭綁木杆的長矛，另有更輕的投槍用於接戰前遠投，兩者形製相近而重量與握法不同；卡面這一型出自尼羅河谷，與本役相隔一千四百餘年，但它代表的工藝譜系正是本役步兵近身戰的骨幹。除長矛外，交戰雙方通用的還有複合反曲弓與箭、銅斧與斧形近戰兵器、石鎚、投石索、小型手斧，以及以木為骨架、外包皮革的盾牌；弓手在兩翼掩護，長矛手與投槍手居前。攻城方面，圍城方以土坡與雲梯接近城牆，切斷城門出入，並封住城內的水路與糧道；馬里書信記載拉爾薩城內缺糧，守軍以稈麥、糠秕充作糧食瞞騙城民，援軍抵達後巴比倫軍攻入城中、攀上城牆，並把里姆辛生擒出來。巴比倫在南方多依河道運兵運糧，由專職的河上巡邏兵執行，輜重靠馱獸車隊。原料方面，銅料多由阿塞拜基亞一線輸入，錫的來源至今仍有爭議，長距離商路同時供應部分物資。士兵多無甲胄，靠盾與掩體自保。
kitsEn: The card shows an Egyptian spear of early dynastic craftsmanship, a copper or bronze head lashed to a wooden shaft, the most basic close-combat arm of the Near Eastern Bronze Age. The Mesopotamian foot soldiers of this war used exactly the same family of weapon: a spear with a copper head bound to a wooden shaft, alongside a lighter javelin thrown before contact, the two similar in shape but different in weight and in how they were held. The type on the card comes from the Nile valley and stands more than fourteen hundred years away from this campaign in time, yet the craft tradition it represents is precisely the backbone of close combat in the armies of the day. Besides the spear, both sides used composite recurve bows and arrows, copper axes and other axe-like hand weapons, stone maces, slings, small hand axes, and shields built on a wooden frame and covered with hide; archers screened the flanks while spearmen and javelin men held the front. On the siege side, the besiegers brought earth ramps and scaling ladders up to the walls, closed the gates and cut the water and grain routes into the city; a letter from Mari records that grain had run short inside Larsa and that the garrison disguised the shortage by handing the townsfolk straw, bran and chaff instead, and that after the reinforcements arrived the Babylonian troops entered the city, mounted the walls and brought Rim-Sin out alive. In the south Babylon moved and supplied its troops largely by river, using the dedicated river patrols for the work, with baggage trains carried on pack animals. As for raw materials, copper came in large part from the Aswaw districts, while the source of tin is still debated, and the long-distance trade routes supplied part of the material needs as well. The soldiers for the most part wore no body armour, relying on the shield and on cover.
tactics: 漢摩拉比的戰爭準備以神諭與外交先行。開戰前他要卜問沙瑪什與馬爾杜克，得到肯定答覆後才出兵，並在軍前向士兵宣示自己無故而動此師，是因沙瑪什與馬爾杜克已經答應；同時以書面聯盟與盟邦協調，誓言不必兩王見面，只需在神像前宣讀誓詞並行儀式，他甚至因二十五日為月神辛的忌日而改在三日後於議會前宣誓。對埃什努納的戰役被記為閃電戰：在馬里部隊配合下，出兵後一年之內即完成兼併，比強攻更省時間。對拉爾薩則改用圍城，馬里書信中守軍描述城中以稈麥、糠秕充作糧食瞞騙城民，援軍抵達後巴比倫軍攻入城內、攀上城牆，並把里姆辛生擒出來。埃蘭軍在平原東北部展開時，以方陣與車兵並行推進，縱深上以車兵掩護步卒，步兵以前排投槍遠投、近身以矛與斧決鬥。撤退方略亦見於記載：埃蘭在北方受挫後放棄據點，漢摩拉比立刻接管其放棄的埃什努納，不給對方重整的時間。徵發與補給同樣關鍵：兼併後普查人口以定可徵兵上限，軍人由王田配地，糧秣靠河船與馱獸車隊維持，而河上巡邏兵還要負責水面的警戒與傳訊。
tacticsEn: Hammurabi prepared for war by divination and diplomacy first. Before taking the field he consulted Shamash and Marduk by oracle and only marched out after a favourable answer, and he told his soldiers before the assault that he had not raised this host without cause, since Shamash and Marduk had already answered him. At the same time he coordinated with his allies in writing: the two kings did not need to meet in person to swear an oath, which was recited before the divine symbols with the proper ritual gestures, and he even refused to swear on the twenty-fifth of the month, a day thought unlucky for invoking the moon god Sin, and instead took the oath three days later before his council. The campaign against Eshnunna is described as a lightning war: with Mari's troops in support, the annexation was completed within a year of the advance, which was far cheaper in time than a frontal assault. Against Larsa he switched to a siege instead; the Mari letter describes the garrison passing off straw, bran and chaff as grain to deceive the townsmen, and after the reinforcements arrived the Babylonian troops entered the city, mounted the walls and brought Rim-Sin out alive. When the Elamite army deployed on the north-east of the plain it advanced with infantry blocks and chariots in parallel, chariots screening the infantry in depth, while the foot soldiers threw javelins from the front rank and closed hand to hand with spear and axe. The pattern of withdrawal is also preserved in the sources: after setbacks in the north the Elamites abandoned their positions, and Hammurabi immediately took over the Eshnunna they had left, giving them no time to regroup. Levy and supply were equally decisive: after the annexation a census was taken to fix the ceiling on how many men could be mobilised, soldiers were given land from the royal domain, and grain was kept moving by river craft and pack-animal trains, while the river patrols also kept watch on the waterways and carried messages.
data: 可核的數字大致如下。漢摩拉比在位43年，通行中年代把其統治定於約前1792至前1750年，修訂版則為前1784至前1742年，而各家年代體系最遠可相差近兩百年，本役的起訖年份因此只能給出概數：戰爭自約前1801年埃蘭入寇起，至約前1770年聯盟軍收復埃什努納、埃蘭退出平原為止。馬里書信保存了漢摩拉比在位第18至第32年、即約前1774至前1761年間的政治往來，這是當時兩河政治生活記錄最密的段落；漢摩拉比留下的親筆書信總數超過二百封。關鍵時點是：薩姆西阿杜卒於前1775年，埃什努納在埃蘭撤走後被兼併，拉爾薩於前1763年陷落，拉爾薩泥板另記為前1764年，馬里在前1761至前1759年間被攻滅。巴比倫年號也記下戰果：第7年攻取伊辛與烏魯克、第10年勝馬爾吉姆、第32年勝埃什努納與舒巴爾圖姆及古提烏姆、第37年勝舒巴爾圖姆、土魯克庫姆與古提烏姆的聯軍、第38年洪水致埃什努納河道改道、第39年再勝舒巴爾圖姆。兵制上，漢摩拉比法典第26至41條專列士卒地位，兵分步行兵與河上巡邏兵兩類，逃兵處死；法典序言列出的受巴比倫控制城邦逾三十座。地理上，蘇斯所在的胡茲斯坦平原距底格里斯河約一百二十公里，蘇斯至巴比倫的直線距離約五百公里，行程須穿過札格羅斯山脈的多個缺口。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. Hammurabi reigned for 43 years; the Middle chronology used by convention places his rule at about 1792 to 1750 BC, a revised version at 1784 to 1742 BC, and the competing chronologies differ by as much as nearly two centuries, so the span of this war can only be given approximately: it runs from the Elamite incursion of about 1801 BC to about 1770 BC, when the coalition recovered Eshnunna and Elam withdrew from the plain. The Mari letters preserve the political correspondence of the eighteenth to the thirty-second year of Hammurabi's reign, roughly 1774 to 1761 BC, the best documented stretch of political life in the two rivers at the time; more than two hundred letters in Hammurabi's own hand survive in total. The key moments are these: Samsi-Addu died in 1775 BC; Eshnunna was annexed after the Elamites withdrew; Larsa fell in 1763 BC, with the Larsa tablets dating the conquest to 1764 BC; Mari was destroyed between 1761 and 1759 BC. The Babylonian year names preserve the results: the seventh year the taking of Isin and Uruk, the tenth year a victory over Malgium, the thirty-second year a victory over Eshnunna together with Shubartum and Gutium, the thirty-seventh year a victory over the coalition of Shubartum, Turukkum and Gutium, the thirty-eighth year the floods that changed the course of the Diyala and ruined Eshnunna, the thirty-ninth year a further victory in Shubartum. On the military system, sections 26 to 41 of the Code of Hammurabi deal with the status of soldiers, who are divided into foot soldiers and river patrols, and desertion is punishable by death; the prologue of the code lists more than thirty cities under Babylonian control. Geographically, the Khuzestan plain in which Susa lay is about 120 km from the Tigris, the direct line from Susa to Babylon is about 500 km, and any march had to pass through several of the gaps in the Zagros range.
cause: 起因是多層積累。埃蘭本以伊朗高原西南為本，控制跨越高原與札格羅斯山脈的商路，也佔有製造青銅原料的關鍵通道；前1801年前後，埃蘭先向位於迪亞拉河谷、正卡在山口與平原之間的埃什努納動手，輕易滅之，首次把勢力伸入美索不達米亞平原，隨即威脅整片平原上的兩河城邦。巴比倫與拉爾薩自阿摩利特人建國以來南北相爭，埃蘭看準時機，拉攏拉爾薩的里姆辛，又暗中分化巴比倫與拉爾薩的關係；兩位國王識破手腕，轉而結盟，才有了後來的聯軍。北方局勢同樣推波助瀾：薩姆西阿杜前1775年死後上美索不達米亞王國迅速瓦解，埃什努納與馬里爭奪真空，埃蘭趁虛而入。巴比倫自身則面對直接的領土要求：埃什努納被埃蘭佔領，漢摩拉比依王權邏輯要求接管，埃什努納貴族以立平民出身的族長西利辛為王拖延，讓談判拖了整整一年，隨即被巴比倫以閃電戰終結。事後看，漢摩拉比的行動帶有明顯的 opportunism：他並不自居好戰之王，銘文裡也不如此描繪，卻總在對手露出破綻時出手。
causeEn: The causes were layered. Elam had its base in the south-west of the Iranian plateau, controlled the trade routes across the plateau and the Zagros, and held the passes through which the raw material for bronze travelled; at about 1801 BC it struck first at Eshnunna, which sat in the Diyala valley right where the mountain gaps open onto the plain, took it easily, and for the first time extended its power into the Mesopotamian plain, thereby threatening every city state of the two rivers. Babylon and Larsa had been rivals from north to south since the Amorite dynasties were founded, and Elam seized the chance, drawing Rim-Sin of Larsa to its side and sowing dissension between Larsa and Babylon; the two kings saw through the manoeuvre and turned instead into alliance, and only then did the coalition come into being. Conditions in the north helped as well: after Samsi-Addu died in 1775 BC his kingdom in Upper Mesopotamia fell apart quickly, Eshnunna and Mari competed over the vacancy, and Elam moved into the gap. Babylon was itself the object of a direct territorial claim: Eshnunna had been taken by Elam, and by the logic of kingship Hammurabi required it back; the notables of Eshnunna stalled by enthroning a commoner clan chief, Silli-Sin, so that the negotiations dragged on for a full year, and the matter was then settled by Babylonian lightning war. Seen afterwards, Hammurabi's conduct is marked by a plain opportunism: he did not present himself as a warlike king and his inscriptions do not paint him as one, but he always moved when an opponent showed a crack.
impact: 直接後果是兩河地緣版圖的改寫。埃蘭退回伊朗高原，此後數百年再未能在美索不達米亞平原建立長期統治；埃什努納併入巴比倫，馬里被毀，中部幼發拉底與上美索不達米亞出現長期真空，阿舒爾沙杜魯等亞述君主於漢摩拉比晚年及其子薩姆蘇伊盧納時代趁隙崛起。巴比倫由二等城邦變成列強，其王城地位上升，後來漢摩拉比法典把這段統一經驗寫成萬民之正義的政治宣傳。更深遠的影響在史料層面：馬里與拉爾薩的泥板因戰後行政運作而大量留存，保存了書信、帳目、軍務與司法紀錄，漢摩拉比留下的二百餘封信尤其完整，使學界得以重建舊巴比倫時期的戰爭、外交與經濟，這批文字最終也進入亞述巴尼拔時代的泥板圖書。軍制與治理模式同樣被後世承襲：以神諭決定是否開戰、以王田土地回饋服役、以普查決定徵兵上限的做法，成為後來亞述與巴比倫諸王模仿的範式；而一場以聯盟、閃電戰與圍城組合起來的勝利，也示範了後世近東君主最偏好的兩種取勝方式。
impactEn: The immediate consequence was a redrawing of the political geography of the two rivers. Elam withdrew to the Iranian plateau and for centuries afterwards never established lasting rule on the Mesopotamian plain; Eshnunna was folded into Babylon, Mari was destroyed, and a long vacancy opened over the middle Euphrates and Upper Mesopotamia, into which Assyrian kings such as Ashur-shallu-lu-lu advanced in the late years of Hammurabi and during the reign of his son Samsu-iluna. Babylon changed from a second-rank city into a great power, its royal city rose in standing, and the Code of Hammurabi later turned this experience of unification into the political claim of justice for all the people. The deeper effect lies in the documentary record: the tablets of Mari and Larsa survived in bulk because administration continued after the conquests, preserving letters, accounts, military paperwork and judicial records, and the more than two hundred letters of Hammurabi are complete enough for scholars to reconstruct the wars, the diplomacy and the economy of Old Babylonia; this body of writing eventually entered the library of Nineveh in the time of Ashurbanipal. The military and administrative model was inherited as well: deciding by oracle whether to go to war, rewarding service with land from the royal domain, and fixing the ceiling of the levy by census became formulas imitated by later Assyrian and Babylonian kings, and a victory assembled out of alliance, lightning war and siege demonstrated the two methods Near Eastern kings preferred ever after.
result: 結局由三步構成。第一，聯盟軍把埃蘭軍逐出美索不達米亞平原北部，埃蘭失去在兩河的全部駐軍，約前1770年戰局收束，卡面年份即取此收官之年。第二，漢摩拉比在戰勝埃蘭後立刻把矛頭轉向自己的南方宿敵：先兼併埃什努納，再於前1763年打下拉爾薩，里姆辛一世被生擒帶出城門，城市落入巴比倫統治；其後北征，前1761至前1759年間攻滅馬里，前1760年前後在舒巴爾圖姆、土魯克庫姆與古提烏姆的聯軍面前取勝並入主亞述城，埃什努納最終毀於洪水與河道改道。第三，成果極不穩固：漢摩拉比本人於前1750年去世，其子薩姆蘇伊盧納雖繼位，卻很快失去拉爾薩等南方領地，巴比倫的統一只維持了一代人。從長期看，埃蘭仍是伊朗高原的強國，兩河內部重歸分裂，這場戰爭確立的是巴比倫一時的霸權與一整套的統治技術，而不是長久的秩序。
resultEn: The outcome was made up of three steps. First, the coalition drove the Elamite army out of the north of the Mesopotamian plain; Elam lost every garrison it had in the two rivers, the war was closed by about 1770 BC, and it is this closing year that the card takes. Second, once he had beaten Elam, Hammurabi turned his weapons at once on his own southern rivals: he annexed Eshnunna, then took Larsa in 1763 BC, with Rim-Sin I led out alive and the city passing under Babylonian rule; he then campaigned north, destroyed Mari between 1761 and 1759 BC, won against the coalition of Shubartum, Turukkum and Gutium around 1760 BC and took Assur, while Eshnunna was finally ruined by flood and by the river changing its course. Third, the results were extremely unstable: Hammurabi himself died in about 1750 BC, and although his son Samsu-iluna succeeded him, he soon lost Larsa and the southern territories, and Babylonian rule lasted barely one generation. In the long term Elam remained a power on the Iranian plateau and the two rivers fell back into division, so what this war established was Babylonian supremacy for a time and a complete set of governing techniques, not any lasting order.
